sections.heading: Operating rules
paragraphs: The policy applies to US production accounts and the Pune engineering center. Critical vulnerabilities must be remediated within 15 calendar days of discovery. The exception board may approve a dated compensating control before the deadline.

Administrative service identities may use only federated short-lived credentials; static access keys and standing AdministratorAccess are forbidden. Quarterly IAM review is signed by a second approver.

sections.heading: Monitoring
paragraphs: EDR must report healthy for every managed endpoint, including contractor devices. The SOC ingests AWS Security Hub findings and records triage each shift.

sections.heading: Continuity
paragraphs: The recovery tier for patient telemetry has a 60-minute RTO and 15-minute RPO. Monthly restore tests and annual tabletop exercises are required.
